verdict.rationale: ClickHouse publishes an official MCP server in its own GitHub org (ClickHouse/mcp-clickhouse, described as 'Connect ClickHouse to your AI assistants'), and a first-party docs guide covers choosing an MCP client or framework to connect an AI assistant. A probe independently confirms the official MCP server is documented. Missing for 10: details on the exposed tools, auth and setup in the evidence, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using it.
